mapper.insert: insert into coupon_source_grant (source_type, source_id, member_id, coupon_id, created_at) values (#{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{memberId}, #{couponId}, now()) on duplicate key update source_id = source_id
mapper.update: update coupon_source_grant set history_id = #{historyId}, delivered_at = now() where source_type = #{sourceType} and source_id = #{sourceId} and history_id is null
